name: 89012 · Henderson, NV
findings: ZIP 89012 (Henderson) has 107 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 35 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89012 (Henderson) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 89012 (Henderson) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 33% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 43 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
